facades.name: tower street front
facades.note: Rectified 2016 panorama, 38.8 px/m. Ground storey glazed behind the 2016 hoarding (null). First floor: three ribbons (west corner 0-4.3 m, middle 11.45-28.0 m, east corner 36.3 m to the corner). Two ribbons stacked near the top over the middle one. Span: native T ~ u over the tower only (the Fedlev front stands 1.45 m further south west of u -5.5).

facades.name: Fedlev street front
facades.note: Rectified 2022 panorama, 45.9 px/m. Ground storey glazed all along (null: one continuous curtain behind trees and bicycles). Screen storey: one glazed bay with its folded shutter (17.9-20.1 m from the west end); the rest is expanded-metal screen.

facades.name: Fedlev north front
facades.note: Fedlev-vleugel (5), nearly frontal from the courtyard. Ground storey glazed (null; the landing stands in front of it). Screen storey from the east end: the long loggia between its two folded shutters (3.2-14.2 m) and the short recessed loggia west of it (15.5-18.2 m); the stair slot (18.2-21.3 m) shows the white flight, not glass. Depth band 2 m: the landing (4.5 m out) is excluded by the front plane on the screen line. Span in the north elevation's own axis (T ~ -u: 5..35 m is the wing, u -35..-5).
